note: Pets are lower to the ground with a different silhouette than humanoid residents, so this will likely need a lighter pet-specific rig rather than reusing the humanoid controller as-is (same state machine and behaviour-weighting concepts should still apply). Fits the dog+bone interaction (digs up hidden treasure).

visualReference.description: Small chibi dog, dark near-black body, teal/green face-and-back patches, orange floral marks scattered across the body, large upright ears (red inside), big round gold-ringed eyes with dark pupils, gold-tipped curled tail, orange paws.
visualReference.note: This confirmed pose is a 3/4 turn, not a clean cardinal-direction front view -- do not wire it into idle_down as-is. Use it as the style/color reference when requesting front/back/left/right poses.
